faqs.a:
Section 101.5. Engineering standards,
is hereby added to read as follows:
"
101.5. Engineering standards.
All references to "Arvada Engineering Standards" shall be to the City of Arvada Engineering
                  Code of Standards and Specifications for the Design and Construction of Public Improvements,
                  as adopted by reference into the city Code at A.C.C.
section 78-261
or any successor ordinance."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 11, 9-14-2020)
